h: The Small Aleph Prepares Moshe for Divine Revelation

p: In the holy Zohar (III 3, beginning of amud a):
and it is the letter Vav, etc.;
וּבָטַשׁ בְּכָל אִינּוּן נְצִיצִין דְּאַתְוָון כַּחֲדָא
and strikes all those sparks of the letters together:
the sparkle of the letter Vav in the Yud,
the sparkle of the Yud in the Kuf,
the sparkle of the Kuf in the Reish,
the sparkle of the Reish in the Aleph,
a voice came forth from among them,
and they join together in this secret:
all those days that he did not enter."
although Moshe Rabbeinu was in truth
a chariot for the Name Havayah,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק ג רמו, ב)
as is written in the holy Zohar (III 246b):
"in his level, the Tiferes of Yisrael";
and in the Tikkunim (Tikkun 13, the eighth, in the thanksgiving):
this from the body and this from the soul";
and it is the middle bar,
And this is what the holy Zohar says here:
and it is the letter Vav," etc.
And to him in truth were transmitted the words of Torah
like the Torah of the World to Come.
מִכָּל מָקוֹם מֹשֶׁה רַבֵּינוּ הָיָה סָבוּר
And his preparation from his own side
so that he could enter the Ohel Mo'ed above,
was through his attribute, which is the Vav,
toward the sparkle of the letter Yud,
the head of the Holy Name,
וְאַחַר כָּךְ נְצִיצוּ דְּי׳ בְּק׳ כוּ׳
And afterward "the sparkle of the Yud in the Kuf," etc.:
for the letters Kuf-Reish are from the Other Side,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב הַזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק א ב, ב)
they took the letter Shin among them"
"From here: whoever wishes to speak falsehood
should first take a foundation of truth";
Shin is the letter of truth,
of the Avos, who are united in it;
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק ב רד, א)
and as is written in the holy Zohar (II 204a):
"Shin is the secret of the three Avos," etc.;
וּכְתִיב (מִיכָה ז, כ) תִּתֵּן אֱמֶת לְיַעֲקֹב
and it is written (Michah 7:20): "Give truth to Yaakov";
and this is what it says, that Shin is the letter of truth.
"He made the letter Kuf king," etc.,
for Adar is the time of the eradication of Amalek,
which is the root of the yetzer hara,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב זוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק ג קס, א)
as is written in the holy Zohar (III 160a):
And it is a preparation for the month of Nisan,
in which they were redeemed from Hashem Yisbarach's side
and this is what they said in Megillah (6b):
"placing redemption next to redemption is preferable."
And with the letter Reish the sixth day was created,
as is written (in Sefer Yetzirah, chapter 4);
that is, then Adam HaRishon was created,
to be the tzaddik, foundation of the world;
and he was created on the sixth day,
which is the attribute of Yesod.
nevertheless close to the entry of Shabbos,
which is in the addition to Shabbos,
which is then the days of Mashiach,
וַיַּרְא אֱלֹקִים אֶת כָּל אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה
"And God saw all that He had made,
and behold, it was very good":
שֶׁאָז מָצָא כָּל הַבְּרִיאָה חֵן בְּעֵינָיו
for then all of Creation found favor in His eyes
הַלְוַאי תְּהֵא מַעֲלוֹת חֵן לְפָנַי תָּמִיד
may you always find favor before Me
as you have found it before Me at this moment";
that from everything there will be "very good."
except that which emerges from within darkness,
except that which emerges from within evil
And this is what it says, "the sparkle of the Yud in the Kuf":
for then will be the eradication of Amalek,
and "the sparkle of the Kuf in the Reish,"
to repair so that everything will be very good;
וְאַחַר כָּךְ נְצִיצוּ דְּר׳ בְּא׳ זְעִירָא
and afterward "the sparkle of the Reish in the small Aleph."
זֶה הָיָה הַהֲכָנָה מִצַּד מֹשֶׁה רַבֵּינוּ
This was the preparation from Moshe Rabbeinu's side,
that he could come into the Ohel Mo'ed,
and Kesser Elyon is the crown of Malchus.

p: And this is what it says:
they were rolling in their combinations,
that were transmitted to Adam in the Garden of Eden."
וְהַיְינוּ כְּמוֹ אָדָם הָרִאשׁוֹן בְּגַן עֵדֶן
That is, like Adam HaRishon in Gan Eden
and the combination began with the letter Aleph,
and gave place to the letter Aleph";
for in truth the Vav includes
the entire Name Havayah, blessed is He,
with the crown of the Yud,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (י, ב; סה, ב)
as is written in the holy Zohar (III 10b; 65b).
and the Yud entered between the Kuf and the Reish."
will be from Hashem Yisbarach's side,
regarding the dispute of Rabbi Eliezer and Rabbi Yehoshua:
they will be redeemed in Tishrei,
and according to Rabbi Yehoshua in Nisan
and they follow their own views
and then the time is in Tishrei;
and when they are not worthy
and are redeemed through Hashem's kindness,
וְלָכֵן הַיּוּ״ד עָאל בֵּין ק׳ וְר׳
Therefore the Yud entered between the Kuf and the Reish,
(Yeshayahu 13:12) "I will make man more precious than fine gold";
for fine gold is a scarce thing in the world,
of fine gold came down to the world," etc.
And even according to what Tosafos wrote
and Moshe Rabbeinu is more precious than that,
meaning that he is unique in the world,
"And no prophet has arisen again like Moshe."
was not shown to Moshe's eye, etc.,
is not made known before him," etc.
and as Yisrael merited for a moment
at the time of the splitting of the Sea,
and the holy Zohar, Beshalach, II 60a):
Hashem Yisbarach did not reveal the combination
"I will make man more precious than fine gold,"
which indicates that he is unique among the prophets;
and as it says in praise of the words of Torah
(תְּהִלִּים יט, יא) הַנֶּחֱמָדִים מִזָּהָב וּמִפַּז רָב
(Tehillim 19:11): "more desirable than gold, than much fine gold."
the combination of the letters Vayikra
and it is written 'and He called Aharon and Miriam,'"
וּכְתִיב פֶּה אֶל פֶּה אֲדַבֶּר בּוֹ וְגוֹ׳
and it is written: "Mouth to mouth I speak with him, etc.,
"in all My house he is trusted."
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב (זֹהַר חֵלֶק ב כא, ב)
as it is written, 'in all My house he is trusted,'
(and see there in the gloss of Rabbi Chaim Vital).
And this is what we say:
"Moshe will rejoice in the gift of his portion,
for You called him a faithful servant."
But Moshe Rabbeinu, in his humility,
all those days that he did not enter
at the combination of the letters Vayikra.
And this itself was the preparation from his side
within the cloud that covers the Mishkan above,
